title: Dog Boarding Near Cooper City, FL: Cage Free Home Boarding

body: Looking for dog boarding near Cooper City? Four Paws Inn is a family run, cage free dog boarding home in Miramar, just south of Cooper City. Here is how it works.
## A home, not a kennel
Your dog stays in our family home with a real backyard. No kennel rows. Dogs go outside to play every hour, and they rest in a calm house.
## New dogs start slow
We have a careful intro process for new dogs, and we always take it slow. New dogs explore the house and the yard first, then meet the group when they are ready.
## You will see how they are doing
One daily video update is included with every stay.
## Price
Dogs under 50 lb are $60 a day. Dogs over 50 lb are $75 a day. Puppies and senior dogs are $80 a day. Each additional dog gets $5 a day off. Pick up before 10 AM and your last day is free.
## Drop off and pick up
Seven days a week, 9 AM to 12 PM or 4 PM to 6:30 PM. We are at 1700 SW 137th Way, Miramar, FL 33027.
## What to bring
Their food, one meal per Ziploc bag, their leash, and any medicine they take. Vaccines must be current. We have beds and supplies.
## Ready to book?
Send us your dates and tell us about your dog. Call or text (754) 277 2325, or book at fourpawsinn.co. A 25% deposit holds your dates. Four Paws Inn has 230+ Google reviews and a 4.9 star rating.

title: Thanksgiving and Christmas Dog Boarding in Broward: How to Hold Your Dates

body: Holiday weeks are the busiest time of year for dog boarding in Broward. If you are traveling for Thanksgiving or Christmas, here is how to hold your dog's spot at Four Paws Inn in Miramar.
## Step 1: Send us your dates
Text (754) 277 2325 or book at fourpawsinn.co with your drop off and pick up dates. Tell us about your dog, too.
## Step 2: Fill out the guest form
We ask about your dog's routine, food, and how they do with other dogs. Then we send the boarding agreement by email to sign.
## Step 3: Pay the 25% deposit
A 25% deposit holds your dates. The rest is due at drop off. Your spot is not held until the deposit is paid.
## First time with us?
Every new dog stays one overnight with us first, at our normal daily rate. It lets your dog get to know the house and the group before a long holiday stay. Plan it a few weeks before your trip.
